subject.title: googlechat: deliver media as a text link when attachment upload is unauthorized (app auth)

question: Should maintainers continue with this branch as the canonical Google Chat app-auth media fallback candidate after repair, or route the canonical fix to https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/89906?
rationale: The same bug has overlapping open candidate work, and this external PR still needs code fixes plus contributor-supplied real behavior proof before merge.

options.title: Repair this branch before merge
options.body: Keep this PR open and require the narrower upload-scope predicate, metadata preservation, and inspectable app-auth proof before final review.

options.title: Use the member candidate
options.body: Prefer https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/89906 only if maintainers decide it is the cleaner canonical path and it remains proof-positive and mergeable.

options.title: Pause this branch
options.body: Pause or close this PR if a different canonical implementation is selected for the linked issue.
